mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the warm and cold vessel responses was most worthwhile: wider vessels brought warm blood near the skin, while narrower vessels reduced heat loss.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the sweat glands was less worthwhile than the direct combinations, though it clarified the required sequence and combined them automatically.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the warm skin circulation had to come before the sweat-gland combination; the earlier signal picture pointed to both.

arbitrary.text: The required order of the warm responses was not obvious from the signal picture, which showed routes to both vessels and glands.

continue.text: I would probably continue: comparing the two responses helped me see how the same skin can either release or conserve heat, and shivering added another way to respond to cold.
